purpose: Labelled candidate/existing pairs for choosing an NLI checkpoint for the merge step.
how_to_read: Each pair is a new candidate sentence and a stored entry it is adjudicated against.
`expect` is the merge verdict a person says is right: supersede, duplicate, update or distinct.
`group` decides what the pair may be used for. 'written' pairs are hand-written for this file
and are the ones a checkpoint is CHOSEN on. 'observed' pairs were taken from real benchmark
runs, so choosing a model on them would be selecting on the test set; they are reported
separately and never used for the decision. The final check is always a benchmark run.
